comments: Training-data augmentation experiment on top of the best result so far (single-frame finetune, 0.3684 val dice, peak at epoch 216 then overfitting -- val loss/dice both degrade through epoch 300 while train loss stays flat, a genuine overfitting signature, not the class-imbalance-looking plateau assumed earlier). Adds GainJitter (log-uniform amplitude scaling, 0.7-1.4x per sample) and NoiseJitter (per-pixel multiplicative noise ~N(1,0.05)) to kurals/loaders/dataloaders.py, wired through get_transformations()'s 'gain'/'noise' names -- both apply only at train time, mask untouched. Same architecture/init/lr as kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_finetune.json otherwise, so augmentation is the isolated variable. Tests whether the training peak itself goes higher with more regularization, not just whether the existing checkpoint's overfit tail can be avoided (already handled by using the best-val-dice checkpoint, unrelated to this experiment).
